Report Title: How Fast Is Autonomous AI Cyber Capability Advancing?
Finding: GPT-5.5 substantially exceeded the previous autonomous-cyber-capability doubling-rate trend: it achieved 100% success on five of six long-duration cyber tasks (8+ hours) within the 2.5M-token budget, solved the sixth long task on every attempt once the token cap was removed, and completed the 'The Last Ones' cyber range on 3 of 10 attempts.
Company Response: GPT-5.5 System Card classifies the model as High (below Critical) cyber capability under the Preparedness Framework and deploys safeguards: the Trusted Access for Cyber program, controlled access to scaled agentic vulnerability research and exploit-chaining, and live monitors/refusals on risky cyber assistance; it reports UK AISI pre-deployment cyber-range testing.

Report Title: Evaluation of Kimi K2 Thinking (Moonshot AI)
Finding: Kimi K2 Thinking showed high censorship of politically sensitive content in Chinese-language queries but substantially less censorship in English, Spanish, and Arabic, raising concerns about differential information access and possible influence operations targeting non-Chinese audiences.
Sources Checked: model card, blog, release notes, news search -- 2026-06-28
Key Quote: CAISI scores systematically lower than Kimi K2's self-reported benchmark numbers.
Notes: Differential censorship by language is a distinct societal risk finding separate from raw capability. Confidence Low -- limited public documentation of evaluation methodology.
